007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent;
008
009/**
010 * Read-only discovery metadata for an agent team available to the current
011 * database user.
012 * <p>
013 * An available team may be owned by another schema and therefore cannot
014 * necessarily be opened as a mutable {@link com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Team}
015 * handle. Use its team name, including the owner qualification when returned
016 * by the database, with
017 * {@link com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent#runTeam(String,
018 * com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.RunTeamRequest)}.
019 *
020 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ListAvailableTeamsSample.html">
021 *      ListAvailableTeamsSample source</a>
022 * @since 1.1.0
023 */
024public final class AvailableTeam {
025    /** Team name returned by the database discovery operation. */
026    private final String teamName;
027    /** Team description returned by the database, when available. */
028    private final String description;
029    /** Original JSON object retained for forward-compatible fields. */
030    private final String rawJson;
031
032    /**
033     * Creates a discovery snapshot.
034     *
035     * @param teamName team name returned by the database
036     * @param description team description, if provided
037     * @param rawJson original JSON object returned by the database, if provided
038     * @throws IllegalArgumentException when {@code teamName} is null or blank
039     */
040    public AvailableTeam(String teamName, String description, String rawJson) {
041        if (teamName == null || teamName.isBlank()) {
042            throw new IllegalArgumentException("teamName must not be null or blank");
043        }
044        this.teamName = teamName;
045        this.description = description;
046        this.rawJson = rawJson;
047    }
048
049    /**
050     * Returns the team name reported by the database.
051     *
052     * @return team name
053     */
054    public String getTeamName() {
055        return teamName;
056    }
057
058    /**
059     * Returns the team description reported by the database.
060     *
061     * @return description, or {@code null} when none was returned
062     */
063    public String getDescription() {
064        return description;
065    }
066
067    /**
068     * Returns the original JSON object for forward-compatible access to
069     * discovery fields introduced by a newer database release.
070     *
071     * @return raw JSON object, or {@code null} when no JSON representation was retained
072     */
073    public String getRawJson() {
074        return rawJson;
075    }
076}
